```{r}
source("recipe_runtime.R")
analysis_data <- readRDS("../output/derived/analysis_data.rds")
validation <- jsonlite::read_json("../output/derived/data_validation.json", simplifyVector = TRUE)
config <- analysis_data$config
```

## Validation status

```{r}
status_table <- data.frame(
  check = names(validation$checks),
  passed = unlist(validation$checks, use.names = FALSE),
  row.names = NULL
)
knitr::kable(status_table)
```

## Study dimensions

```{r}
dimension_table <- data.frame(
  field = c("Domain", "Samples", "Features", "Grouping variable"),
  value = c(
    analysis_data$domain,
    length(analysis_data$sample_ids),
    length(analysis_data$feature_ids),
    config$variables$grouping %||% "Not configured"
  )
)
knitr::kable(dimension_table)
```

## Input provenance

```{r}
path_values <- vapply(config$paths, function(value) value %||% "Not provided", character(1))
input_table <- data.frame(role = names(path_values), path = unname(path_values), row.names = NULL)
knitr::kable(input_table)
```

The analysis proceeds only from the aligned samples and validated feature matrix recorded above. Any excluded or unmatched identifiers remain available in the machine-readable validation artifact.

## Reproducibility

sessionInfo()
